_readme: Unprinted cards: upgrades that exist only as text in a rules document (e.g. the command upgrades in the Official XWA Epic Rules). Each card: id, name, type, slot, restriction, text (the quoted card text, word for word), source (a document id from sources.json), page, rule (the rules entry that explains it), optional aliases, epic: true to show it only in Epic mode, and playtest: true to add the green Playtest label. Never add points or loadout values. The build warns if a card's text no longer appears in its document, so re-check these after a new version of the document.

cards.name: Wing Leader
cards.text: You are a Wing Leader. While defending, the wingmate in play that is not destroyed with the highest ID number suffers all damage instead of you.

cards.name: Wingmate
cards.text: You are a Wingmate. You are considered to have the same Configuration upgrade as your Wing Leader.

cards.name: Commander
cards.restriction: Limited ship, Medium or Large ship
cards.text: You are a commander. While defending, the wing guard in play that is not destroyed with the highest ID number suffers all damage instead of you.

cards.name: Wing Guard
cards.text: You are a Wing Guard. While an enemy ship performs an attack against a friendly commander in your formation, if you obstruct the attack, the defender rolls 1 additional die.
